recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless the terminology work group separately decides to reintroduce diagnosis/procedure-specific ICD-9-CM identifiers or move additional ICD identifier detail from THO back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-8903 is a Published/Persuasive vocab change request for DSTU1/DSTU2 asking to correct the typo in http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm/diagosis for the ICD-9-CM diagnosis system URI.
initial_application: Jira's comment identifies svn revision 7183. The corresponding git-svn commit 9eff2268e43126ba48c4aaced9d6fb3087969e2c (#8903 - correct icd9 url) changed source/terminologies-systems.html from diagosis to diagnosis and filled the ICD-9-CM diagnosis/procedure code system OIDs in that old table row.
additional_context: FHIR-8904 is the same-change-family issue for the same typo and is already represented on the combined branch; its Jira comment confirms the typo was already fixed and rejects a suggested value set OID as not a code system OID. Later terminology work in commit 3e1ab0a91d removed the old ICD-9-CM diagnosis/procedure row, and FHIR-41305/commit 11181dd489 corrected the current ICD URI column to the root ICD-9-CM and ICD-10 URIs.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source has no diagosis occurrence, and the active Code Systems page now lists http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm with links from the terminology module/hierarchy.
